kind: ADDITIVE and IMMUTABLE. One single-variable experiment. rev4b, its addendum, its receipts and its report are NOT mutated

ARCHITECTURAL_FRAMING_BINDING.what_the_68_cap_IS: a CONTROLLED DAgger COLLECTION BUDGET, chosen to restore the July round's on-policy share of 35.23% and thereby isolate the hypothesis that rev4b's 75.82% share caused the closed-loop collapse
what_the_68_cap_IS_NOT: NOT a 'causally valid prefix': the audit established that the July truncation operator compares a PERTURBED trace against the same actor's nominal trace and is inapplicable here, and that the 13/14 figures in the rev4b rollout receipt describe rev4b's own 42-step rollout, not the S1A prefix
NOT a literal replication of the July incident: July's 68 rows were the ENTIRE trace of a clone that died at step 68; here 68 is a deliberate cut of a 392-row trace
NOT a promotion of any kind
ARCHITECTURAL_FRAMING_BINDING.fidelity_statement: rev4c is faithful to the July BALANCE and, by construction, NOT faithful to the July OPERATOR (which never truncated a DAgger prefix). It is the mirror image of rev4b, which was operator-faithful and balance-divergent. Neither may be called 'July-faithful' without this qualification
ARCHITECTURAL_FRAMING_BINDING.experiment_type: single variable: the on-policy share, 75.82% -> 35.23%. Everything else is byte-identical to rev4b

dataset.teacher_corpus: the BC-IK corpus: obs35 visited by S0D on the frozen nominal trace, labels u_IK AB06 SAME-STEP from the pinned cache 3dd878d4...
dataset.on_policy_prefix: the FIRST 68 CONTIGUOUS rows of the frozen S1A nominal rollout (steps 1..68), labels = same-step u_IK at teacher_index = step - 1
dataset.operation: concat(teacher, tile(prefix, 4)); no dedup; the 68 cap is the collection budget, applied BEFORE the July operator
dataset.forbidden_data: no S0D-actor, L20, A2, W2/W4/W8, L05/L10, A1-A6 or rev4b data; JUL_H0 never init nor label

init_and_roles.init: EXCLUSIVELY the S1A actor 8f3e0ce1..., which is also the anchor parameter and the collection policy (its frozen rollout is reused; NO new collection)
init_and_roles.logstd: byte-identical to the S1A placeholder, restored after every optimizer step

july_hyperparameters_verified_and_unchan.source: target_domain_imitation.py:1353-1361 and target_domain_dagger.py:57-67, verified in the rev4b stage

blocking_preflight_no_write: obs35 exact: each row equals its recorded actor_observation_vector_before, width 35, all finite
time alignment exact: max |t_S1A - t_corpus| == 0 over the first 68 rows
no exact duplicates and no collision carrying a CONFLICTING label
on any failure: NO-GO and STOP, no fit

tooling_requirements.no_hardcoded_actor_names: the new analyzer must parameterise the actor label; keys such as kinematics_L20 or L20_vs_S0D_same_states are forbidden
tooling_requirements.no_foreign_offline_reference_block: a receipt must never embed another actor's offline constants; the field is forbidden outright
tooling_requirements.regression_tests: must prove both prohibitions on the produced receipt

binding: integrity invariants (10 keys, clock zero, clock invariance bit-identical, logstd byte-identical to S1A, save/reload exact, no critic)
fit convergence: adapted aggregate RMSE strictly lower than the initial one
reported_without_invented_thresholds: RMSE, Pearson and amplitude ratio per joint on the corpus 500, on the first-68 prefix and on ALL 97 negative-ankle rows of the corpus
max_abs vs the S0D actor: INFORMATIONAL only

closed_loop_stage.trigger: only if every binding offline gate passes
closed_loop_stage.execution: exactly ONE deterministic nominal rollout, 500-step horizon, same frozen harness, no retry
monitored: ankle and knee q with sign and amplitude

primary_causal_test.NO_GO_hypothesis_refuted: <= 100 steps -> the on-policy over-weighting hypothesis is REFUTED and the single-round DAgger direction is closed

CRITERIA.no_automatic_promotion: even if every criterion passes, the candidate is NOT promoted; the architect decides after the audit
